summary: Independent exact-head review blocks PR #329. Strict-first validation can accept already-laundered strict-valid rewrites of allowlisted historical IDs before compatibility provenance is checked, and the fallback rules bind only eventId plus selected fields rather than exact audited path/blob bytes, permitting historical-ID replay or mutation. Recovery must bind exceptions to exact immutable provenance before generic strict validation and reject duplicate/replayed event IDs.
evidence: PR #329 exact head 275ba90dfe699e22b495b6f77086e8c6e845fd11 calls _STRICT_VALIDATE_EVENT(path) before consulting _HISTORICAL_EVENT_COMPAT.
_validate_historical_event checks path.stem == eventId and selected semantic fields but does not bind the allowlisted exception to the exact audited relative path/full blob bytes.
GitHub review 4904461613 records the scheduler REQUEST_CHANGES verdict; formal REQUEST_CHANGES state is unavailable because the PR is authored by the same GitHub account.
